pages.title: Amplifying Resonance
pages.text: I found a way to use resonance. Purifying the material in Draconium into crystals seems to amplify the effect. More interestingly, a crystal can be tuned to accept resonance only within a particular frequency band. The Binder quickly synchronizes the spectra of two crystals.$(br2)$(bold)Synchronize spectrum:$() hold the Binder and sneak-use the first endpoint.$(br)$(bold)Create link:$() use the second endpoint.$(br)The first endpoint must be synchronized again for every new link.

pages.title: Sync Failure
pages.text: If the wrong first endpoint was selected, hold the Binder and sneak-use it in the air to clear the spectrum it remembers. Doing this before rewiring also helps prevent accidental links.$(br2)If the endpoints still do not resonate, measure the distance and count the crystal's existing links. For a wireless crystal, also check how many targets it remembers. Once either limit is reached, it will accept no new link.
